newsitem.title: ESTONIA: LATVIA-ESTONIA'S HOIU SAYS SELL JEKABPILS SUGAR SHARES.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-ESTONIA'S HOIU SAYS SELL JEKABPILS SUGAR SHARES.

text.p: Estonia's Hoiupank on Wednesday said it recommended selling shares in Latvia's Jekabpils Sugar factory at a price of 47 santimes because of its limited market size and low competitiveness.
Jekabils closed five santimes higher on Wednesday at 57 santimes on turnover of 5,400 lats.
"Jekabpils sugar factory is oriented to the domestic market and therefore the market is rather limited," the bank said in a recent equity research report.
Exports may be possible only to eastern Europe as sugar prices are lower and quality is higher in the west, it added.

Competition is still strong although Latvia has set high taxes on sugar imports. In addition to illegal sugar imports, the company faces strong competition from other two sugar producers, Jelgava and Liepaja, it added.
The factory urgently needs large investments in the near future to be able to continue production and face competition, the Estonian bank added.
